notice: AWS and Azure profiles in this file were read from the providers' own machine-readable price lists — the AWS Price List Bulk API and the Azure Retail Prices API — by scripts/refresh-cloud-prices.mjs on 2026-09-23, and carry the provider's publication date in their priceNote. They are on-demand, single-instance, Linux rates in one region each, and are exact quotes of those lists on that date; prices change, and the same script refreshes them. Google Cloud profiles are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders: the Cloud Billing Catalog API needs an API key (set GCP_BILLING_API_KEY to read it), and the pricing web page carries no figures as text. Self-managed profiles have no rates by design. Every profile says which of these it is in its verified flag and priceNote.

profiles.priceNote: Read from the AWS Price List Bulk API (AWSCloudMap, published 2026-09-11T12:45:31Z). On-demand, USD, us-east-1. One registered resource, its monthly charge spread over 730 hours, plus discovery API calls. DNS-based discovery through Route 53 is billed separately and is not modelled.

compute.note: One registered resource, $0.10 a month spread over 730 hours.

requests.note: One lookup = one billed API call.

profiles.label: Service discovery / configuration (unpriced)
profiles.description: Editable cost assumptions. No provider, machine size or deployment region has been selected.
profiles.priceNote: No rates supplied. Unpriced charges are excluded from the numeric subtotal; this service is not free. Enter rates only for the deployment you intend to use.

profiles.label: Secrets Manager, one secret
profiles.description: Managed secrets. Billed per secret per month and per API call.
profiles.priceNote: Read from the AWS Price List Bulk API (AWSSecretsManager, published 2026-09-11T12:46:10Z). On-demand, USD, us-east-1. One secret, its monthly charge spread over 730 hours, plus API calls. Rotation runs a Lambda function, whose cost is not modelled here.

compute.note: One secret, $0.40 a month spread over 730 hours.

requests.note: One fetch = one billed API call.

profiles.label: Secrets manager (unpriced)
profiles.description: Editable cost assumptions. No provider, machine size or deployment region has been selected.
profiles.priceNote: No rates supplied. Unpriced charges are excluded from the numeric subtotal; this service is not free. Enter rates only for the deployment you intend to use.

profiles.label: SES outbound email
profiles.description: Managed email delivery. Billed per recipient; nothing is provisioned.
profiles.priceNote: Read from the AWS Price List Bulk API (AmazonSES, published 2026-09-11T12:45:07Z). On-demand, USD, us-east-1. Email only, one recipient per notification. SMS and push notifications are billed by other services at other rates. Attachments and dedicated IPs are not modelled.

requests.note: One delivery attempt = one recipient billed.

profiles.label: Notification service (unpriced)
profiles.description: Editable cost assumptions. No provider, machine size or deployment region has been selected.
profiles.priceNote: No rates supplied. Unpriced charges are excluded from the numeric subtotal; this service is not free. Enter rates only for the deployment you intend to use.

profiles.label: CloudWatch Logs, Standard class
profiles.description: Managed logging. Billed per GB of records taken in; nothing is provisioned.
profiles.priceNote: Read from the AWS Price List Bulk API (AmazonCloudWatch, published 2026-09-22T02:17:15Z). On-demand, USD, us-east-1. Ingestion into the Standard log class: the run's records times the record size drawn on the component. Log storage ($0.03 per GB-month) is not modelled — at the default sixty-second retention it is negligible — and custom metrics, alarms and dashboards are separate charges not included here.

profiles.label: Monitoring / logging (unpriced)
profiles.description: Editable cost assumptions. No provider, machine size or deployment region has been selected.
profiles.priceNote: No rates supplied. Unpriced charges are excluded from the numeric subtotal; this service is not free. Enter rates only for the deployment you intend to use.

profiles.label: SNS standard topic
profiles.description: A managed topic: one publish, a copy to every subscriber. Billed per publish; delivery to queues is free.
profiles.priceNote: Read from the AWS Price List Bulk API (AmazonSNS, published 2026-09-15T15:19:44Z). On-demand, USD, us-east-1. Paid tier. The first million requests a month are free and are not modelled. Delivery to SQS queues and Lambda is free; HTTP and email deliveries cost extra and are not modelled.

requests.note: One publish = one billed request, however many listeners copy it.

profiles.label: Self-managed topic (no rates)
profiles.description: A broker with topics you run yourself, such as RabbitMQ exchanges or Kafka. Aparecium has no rates for it, so every charge is reported as unpriced rather than as zero.
profiles.priceNote: Deliberately has no amounts. Use this to see how Aparecium reports a charge it cannot price.

requests.note: Depends on the hardware you run the broker on.

profiles.label: Lambda (x86)
profiles.description: Code run per request with nothing provisioned. Billed per invocation and per gigabyte-second alive.
profiles.priceNote: Read from the AWS Price List Bulk API (AWSLambda, published 2026-09-19T00:23:59Z). On-demand, USD, us-east-1. x86, first duration tier (up to 6 billion GB-seconds a month). The free tier — a million requests and 400,000 GB-seconds a month — is not modelled.

requests.note: One invocation = one billed request.

duration.note: Wall-clock time alive times memory allotted, rounded to the millisecond by the provider.

profiles.label: Azure Functions, Consumption plan
profiles.description: Code run per request with nothing provisioned. Billed per execution and per gigabyte-second alive.
profiles.priceNote: Read from the Azure Retail Prices API on 2026-09-23. Pay-as-you-go, USD, eastus. Consumption plan, paid tiers. The free grant — a million executions and 400,000 GB-seconds a month — is not modelled.

requests.note: One execution = one billed request.

duration.note: Wall-clock time alive times memory allotted.

profiles.label: Self-hosted functions (no rates)
profiles.description: A functions platform you run yourself, such as OpenFaaS or Knative. Aparecium has no rates for it, so every charge is reported as unpriced rather than as zero.
profiles.priceNote: Deliberately has no amounts. Use this to see how Aparecium reports a charge it cannot price.

compute.note: Depends on the hardware you run the platform on.

profiles.label: DynamoDB, on-demand
profiles.description: A managed key-value store that scales itself. Billed per read, per write and per GB stored.
profiles.priceNote: Read from the AWS Price List Bulk API (AmazonDynamoDB, published 2026-09-11T12:44:22Z). On-demand, USD, us-east-1. On-demand (pay per request), standard table class. One read request unit per read and one write request unit per write, which holds for items up to 4 KB read and 1 KB written; larger items cost more units. The first 25 GB of storage a month are free and are not modelled.

requests.note: One read = one billed read request unit.

writes.note: One write = one billed write request unit.

profiles.label: Self-managed key-value store (no rates)
profiles.description: A store you run yourself, such as MongoDB, Cassandra or ScyllaDB. Aparecium has no rates for it, so every charge is reported as unpriced rather than as zero.
profiles.priceNote: Deliberately has no amounts. Use this to see how Aparecium reports a charge it cannot price.

compute.note: Depends on the hardware you run the store on.

profiles.label: S3 Standard
profiles.description: Managed object storage. Billed per GB kept, per read and per write.
profiles.priceNote: Read from the AWS Price List Bulk API (AmazonS3, published 2026-09-18T17:47:47Z). On-demand, USD, us-east-1. S3 Standard, first storage tier (up to 50 TB). Reads are GET requests and writes are PUT requests. Transfer out to the internet is billed separately and is not on this profile, since the server in front of the bucket carries the response.

requests.note: One read = one GET request.

profiles.label: Blob Storage, Hot, LRS
profiles.description: Managed object storage. Billed per GB kept, per read and per write.
profiles.priceNote: Read from the Azure Retail Prices API on 2026-09-23. Pay-as-you-go, USD, eastus. General-purpose v2 block blobs, Hot tier, locally redundant, first storage tier (up to 50 TB).

requests.note: One read = one read operation.

profiles.label: Self-managed object storage (no rates)
profiles.description: Storage you run yourself, such as MinIO or Ceph. Aparecium has no rates for it, so every charge is reported as unpriced rather than as zero.
profiles.priceNote: Deliberately has no amounts. Use this to see how Aparecium reports a charge it cannot price.
